entities.name: José Medeiros Ferreira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Manuel de Medeiros Ferreira was a Portuguese politician, historian, and political scientist. He served as Minister of International Negotiations from 1976 to 1977 and was a long-time member of the Portuguese parliament. He also served as a Member of the European Parliament for the second term from 1986 to 1989.
